The '''east Lumbridge Swamp mine''' is a [[List of mines|mine]] that may be found in the south-east section of the [[Lumbridge Swamp]] near a [[Fishing]] site.

Originally, it was the only mine in the Lumbridge Swamp. It was a mine for experienced miners, with [[Coal rocks|coal]], [[Mithril rocks|mithril]], and [[adamantite rocks]]. However, those rocks were moved to the [[West Lumbridge Swamp mine|western mine site]], and the south-east mine has changed to be a new players' mine, with five [[Copper rocks|copper]] and [[tin rocks]].

To get to this mine, players can follow the path which leads south from the graveyard in [[Lumbridge]].

The closest [[bank]] to this mine is in [[Al Kharid]] via the [[crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]] [[Shortcuts|shortcut]]. Players may wish to mine equal quantities of [[Copper ore|copper]] and [[tin ore]] and smelt them into [[bronze bar]]s using Al Kharid's [[furnace]] on the way through. This will add some time to each run; however, the time saved having to run back and forth between the bank and the furnace later on more than makes up for it.
